text:
marco: Heads-up — landed slot-rebalance allocator heuristic yesterday (r/commit 9f3c2b7). Seeing a consistent latency regression on paged-attn for long sequences (>=1024). p50 up ~12%, p99 up ~18% on our cust-prod-like suite. link: https://internal.perf/reports/9f3c2b7 (screenshots + flame)
anya: ack. can you paste the perf numbers and which bench? hosted or dedicated?
marco: Dedicated-nightly oolong workers. micro-bench: batch size 1, seq 1024, model flashvariant-small. baseline p50=42ms -> after=47ms; p99=130ms -> after=153ms. Allocation metrics show ~20% more page walks and higher KV refill stalls.
carmen: do we know if kernel selection changed? that commit touched the slotmap compaction path which can change fragmentation pattern and kernel choice heuristics (we pick kernels by avg seq and residency).
devon: I ran a small repro locally. forced configs:
```
RW_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=flash_v2,fused,flash
RW_PAGED_ALLOC_BUCKETS=64
RW_KV_PAGE_SIZE=32K
```
With kernel forced to fused, regression disappears (p50 ~43ms). With flash_v2 preferred, regression exists.
marco: interesting. that implies it's mostly affecting the kernel selection signal (avg residency / contiguous run length) rather than pure mem overhead.
perf-bot: perf-regression-detect: job=dedicated-nightly; metric=p50_latency; delta=+11.9%; commit=9f3c2b7; alert=auto-opened issue #ENG-6123 :eyes:
anya: can you share the allocator telemetry? e.g., free-run-length histogram, slot fragmentation heatmap, and KV map page occupancy
marco: pasted a short excerpt from the telemetry dump:
```
alloc_stats:
  total_slots: 1_048_576
  avg_run_len_pre: 18.2
  avg_run_len_post: 12.7
  slab_frag_pct_pre: 6.1
  slab_frag_pct_post: 15.9
kv_pager:
  page_walks_per_1k: 84 -> 102
  refill_stalls_per_1k: 12 -> 17
```
carmen: that avg_run_len drop is key — kernel chooser uses run-length tail to decide on contiguous-kernel vs fused. If run-length shortens, we prefer non-fused kernels that have worse IO patterns for our paged pager.
devon: quick experiment: toggled kernel chooser threshold from 256->128 contiguous tokens and re-ran — latency matched baseline. so either revert heuristic or add compensating fast-path in the pager.
anya: we should avoid simply reverting without root cause. possible fixes:
- make kernel chooser more resilient to transient fragmentation (smoothing window)
- have pager expose contiguous span hints to kernel chooser
- change allocator to maintain a small pool of pre-reserved contiguous slots for hot KVs
marco: agreed. I prototyped smoothing (EWMA alpha=0.2 over 128 samples) and the regression goes away in canary. but smoothing delays adaptation for real topology changes.
carmen: another option: when slotmap compaction runs, emit a short "compaction epoch" tag that kernel chooser treats as noisy and increases smoothing gain. cheaper than full revert.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: must run canary on 3 dedicated clusters (eu-west, us-west, ap-south) with seq 512/1024/2048 workloads and traffic mix 80/20 inference vs streaming. healthcheck: p50 within 5% baseline, p99 within 10%.
devon: I also profiled the fused vs flash_v2 kernels. fused has more L2-friendly layout for kv lookups and fewer device-side memcpys when run-length contiguous > 32. that's why fused is robust under fragmentation.
marco: action items:
- revert full rollout of slot-rebalance (I rolled it back on one cluster) — marcos
- land smoothing + compaction-epoch tagging (PR ready: https://git.internal/r/PR/1248) — carmen to review
- add canary plan (ops-bot above) — ops-team
- add unit/regression test for avg_run_len metric to perf suites — devon
anya: adding: also update kernel-chooser telemetry dashboards and include run-length histogram so oncall can quickly diagnose.
carmen: will review PR today. if tests pass, we can ship smoothing and tagging and run canary before reverting the code.
marco: thanks all. leaving the perf issue open: ENG-6123 :thumbsup:
devon: :eyes: I'll run extended stress with seq=2048 overnight and post results tomorrow.
perf-bot: perf-check completed: canary-green after smoothing applied on cluster eu-west-2. p50 delta +2.1% vs baseline, p99 +6.8%. closing temporary alert draft.
